line: Living down on Drury Lane Muffin Man, bitch, I got dough on my hands
meaning:
This is a reference to “The Muffin Man,” an English nursery rhyme and children’s game written around 1820. Fresh-baked goods were often delivered to Victorian households by certain individuals, such as the muffin man.

Do you know the muffin man,
The muffin man, the muffin man.
Do you know the muffin man,
Who lives on Drury Lane?

A muffin is a baked food product made of dough. Ski refers to himself as the muffin man because he has lots of dough, which is slang for money.

Ski Mask interpolates the lyrics and replicates the flow famously used by XXXTENTACION in his breakout hit “Look At Me!”:

Ayy, I’m like, “Bitch, who is your mans?” (Ayy)
Can’t keep my dick in my pants (Ayy)

Originally released in 2015, “Look At Me!” received a massive surge in popularity in late January 2017, when plagiarism claims arose after Drake previewed and released “KMT,” which had a similar sounding flow.

Ski Mask performing "Look At Me" at The Rave/Eagles Club on 05/31/2019, one year after X's passing.




Ski has paid homage to his late friend many times since X passed: he mentioned him on “Empty,” on “How You Feel? (Freestyle),” and on “Ghost Busters.” More recently, he sampled the first verse of their 2017 collaboration “What in XXXTarnation” in his 2019 release “Carbonated Water”.
